subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should this PR receive a proof exception for the non-inducible xAI/Grok rotation error, or should merge wait for redacted after-fix organic Grok/gateway logs?
rationale: External PRs normally need after-fix real behavior proof, but the contributor states the exact code-less xAI decrypt error only occurs when xAI rotates a model snapshot/key and cannot be forced safely on demand; the code/test evidence is strong but does not satisfy the usual proof gate.

options.title: Accept Proof Exception
options.body: Apply a maintainer proof override if the pre-fix production logs, current-main source repro, and positive/negative predicate tests are sufficient for this narrow one-shot retry repair.

options.title: Wait For Organic Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a future real xAI/Grok rotation produces redacted gateway logs or terminal output showing the after-fix retry succeeds.

options.title: Pause The PR
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged if maintainers want live provider proof and do not want to carry a proof exception for this class of external API failure.

recommendation.title: Accept Proof Exception
recommendation.body: Apply a maintainer proof override if the pre-fix production logs, current-main source repro, and positive/negative predicate tests are sufficient for this narrow one-shot retry repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent OpenAI/xAI runtime history makes this the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency decision.
